contract.consistency: One authoritative instance per backend. Committed seed/live rows must be visible to new autocommit reads. No replica/HA claim.
contract.atomicity: Single INSERT acknowledgements only. General COPY error atomicity, multi-key transactions and snapshot-isolation anomalies are not qualified.
contract.cedar_durability: Every Go connection sets and reads back async_commit=off. Native backup requires v2026-11-18. Process SIGKILL is tested separately from physical power loss.
contract.postgres_durability: Every Go connection sets and reads back synchronous_commit=on. Server fsync and full_page_writes remain enabled.
contract.restore: Require all seed rows and every ACK witnessed before backup invocation. Reconcile later ACKs separately as measured snapshot RPO. Restore a clone on new owned storage; never mutate the backup archive.
